note: Backend configuration. mode: 'demo' stores everything in this browser (zero setup, perfect for a pilot). 'supabase' uses a real database + real admin login. Webhook automations fire in ANY mode when webhookUrl is set: point it at Zapier/Make/n8n/Resend to fan out to email, texts, or a CRM. See docs/BACKEND.md. applianceUrl/applianceToken point Admin -> Assistant at the church's local Ollama box once it exists — see docs/APPLIANCE-SETUP.md. Both blank is a normal, fully-supported state (Assistant just shows 'not connected yet'). Staff roles: adminPasscode signs in as ADMIN (everything), editorPasscode as EDITOR (events, announcements, ministries, reservations, go-live — no people/prayer/settings). CHANGE-ME: replace BOTH passcodes before the first link goes out; they are courtesy locks until supabase mode is on, and anything committed to a public repository is readable by anyone.
